title: Wire group_log queries into GROUP and LIST ACTIVE commands
description: Replace the hardcoded (0, 0, 0) stub in the GROUP command handler with a live query to group_log::group_range() and group_log::article_count(). Wire LIST ACTIVE to enumerate groups from the group_log storage rather than from config. Why: newsreaders send GROUP before any ARTICLE fetch; returning zero counts causes clients to think groups are empty and skip fetching.
